haiku-low.q4: The password check happens before the save, so the link is apparently not used up. The document does not state this explicitly.

haiku-low.q7: The token is random. Its raw value goes into the email link, and only its SHA-256 hash is stored. The document does not explicitly describe the link step.
haiku-low.q8: NOT STATED. The document only says the token is validated before the new-password form is shown.
haiku-low.q11: Password save, then session revocation, then the confirmation email is queued, then the login page. Whether these form one atomic change is not stated.
haiku-low.q12: NOT STATED. The document says links work once but gives no concurrency mechanism.
